Implemented the CLI IGES tool in [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js) with supporting modules for parsing, writing, diagnostics, schema handling, and parametric evaluation in [output/parse.js](/workspace/output/parse.js), [output/write.js](/workspace/output/write.js), [output/eval.js](/workspace/output/eval.js), [output/schema.js](/workspace/output/schema.js), and [output/errors.js](/workspace/output/errors.js).

I verified the basic end-to-end path locally with:
- `write` from canonical JSON to `.iges`
- `parse` back to canonical JSON
- `query` by DE index
- `eval` on a Line entity
- invalid `write` input producing the required diagnostic JSON with exit code `1`

The entry point is `node /workspace/output/main.js <subcommand> ...`.
